theorems.name: Submission.dohr_eb_ehs_inner_right_holder
theorems.statement: ∀ (n ℓ m : ℕ) (α : ℝ) (U : Set (Rn n)) (g : Rn n → Rn ℓ) (w : Rn ℓ), IsOpen U → IsLocallyHolderCkα m α g U → ContDiffOn ℝ m (fun x => inner ℝ (g x) w) U ∧ ∀ K : Set (Rn n), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ x ∈ K, ∀ y ∈ K, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (fun z => inner ℝ (g z) w) x - iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (fun z => inner ℝ (g z) w) y‖ ≤ C * ‖x - y‖ ^ α
